in_marathi.name: Chitral
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Art, Picture, Sketch
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitral हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘chitra’ meaning ‘art’, ‘picture’, or ‘sketch’. In Hindu mythology, Chitral is a female name associated with creativity and artistic expression.
